fairness.reason: The issue describes only the doc_id/dockey collision for same-DOI papers. The reference fix adds a new public `content_hash` field to Doc/DocDetails, with specific autopopulation and merge semantics and a new doc_id formula. The F2P test `test_pdf_reader_match_doc_details` (the diff is truncated, so I'm inferring) most likely asserts on those new fields or exact values. An agent could fix the collision a different way and still fail. The cassette changes also show the test depends on recorded HTTP interactions.
